descriptionChirho: Piel stem: to gather or collect items, especially sticks or stubble for fuel; a menial subsistence activity. All three clusters represent the same Piel verbal action in different conjugations: participial forms (masc/fem singular) 'gathering' describing ongoing action (eng: gathering, spa: recogiendo, hin: बीनती हुई / लकड़ी बीनते हुए, arb: يَحْتَطِبُ / تَجْمَعُ, kor: 줍는 / 나무 줄기를 모으는, swa: akikusanya), infinitive construct 'to gather' (eng: to gather, spa: para recoger, hin: बीनने के लिये, arb: لِيَجْمَعُوا, swa: kukusanya), and conjunctive perfect 'and let them gather' as jussive (eng: and let them gather, spa: y recogerán, hin: और बीनें, arb: وَيَجْمَعُونَ, swa: na wakusanye). Attested in Nu 15:32-33; Ex 5:7,12; 1Ki 17:10,12.
